result.text:
AI agents can test Flutter UIs without guessing pixels.

flutter-mcp-toolkit gives Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and other agents semantic snapshots, screenshots, taps, form input, hot reload and logs through MCP. Apps can also expose custom tools at runtime.

Its key idea is a shared observe → act → prove loop across the MCP server, CLI and Dart harness. The agent sees what is actually on screen, changes it, reloads, and gets evidence that the intended state is now real.

That makes UI work more inspectable and repeatable for Flutter teams building agent-driven apps. MIT-licensed, Flutter 3.44+.
